authority.decisions: TC14-01 through TC14-06 explicitly owner-approved; proposal bytes remain original Proposed archival decision packet

scope: Exact current implementation draft against approved TC14-01–06 proposal/test/plan and actual existing module APIs; documentary/static only.
conclusion: Corrected exact engineering draft reviewed: prior compatibility wording finding CLOSED; no remaining scoped actionable findings. Historical HTTP omission matches exact-byte compatibility; no product amendment inferred.

checks.result: Approved eight command kinds implement exact TC14 lifecycle; reason serves comment text without extra permission or target-state input.
Accepted exact replay/changed reuse precedes new source/vector checks; fresh duplicate Create has no UUID reservation/event/receipt and ignores existing task revision/status/new eligibility.
Accepted event records observed source and vector; separate immutable creation/latest plan; public historical metadata server-backed, current source coherent.
Current source failure denies writes/replay and suppresses content/actions; separately authorized task-own metadata/history only after stored integrity, category/assignment checks.

Also inspected explicit source-missing selected identity -> SourceUnavailable, fixed UTCZ timestamps, exact unavailable history DTO, trusted actor equality/action grant mapping, nine detail fields and ordered arrays. No additional scoped findings.

recommendations.privatePersistence: Retain exact original accepted command inputs privately with semantic digest to make mandatory command-integrity verification reconstructible.

originalDto.minimalRequiredPublicFields: Reuse each entry.identity plus creation and plan immutable events. Each event supplies eventId, revision, kind, actorId, actorRoles, recordedAtUtc, reason, source (complete metadata ArtifactReviewSourceBinding plus planningTaskContractDigest), selected attestation references and recordedStatus/planningEventId. This supplies original run/input/profile/application/template/package/guidance/finding-review/revision provenance without another historical package DTO.
originalDto.originalContent: Render current coherent existing GuidanceOption text/prerequisites/risk/recoveryGuidance, finding validationGuidance and selected actual three FixArtifacts from existing package response. Label creation/latest plan metadata as historical references backed by server verification. Do not label current text as creation-era text after a source change.
originalDto.optionalCreationTextIfLaterExplicitlyNee: Server may project only the creation source selected GuidanceOption and its selected three fixed fictional FixArtifacts, plus findingId/packageId/scopedOptionId/templateVersion/templateDigest already in metadata, from its verified immutable canonical package. Avoid whole historic guidance/findings/packages/evidence duplication. Current draft does not add this redundant content DTO.
originalDto.history: Metadata source references and selected accepted event/revision vector; complete historical packages stay server-owned and are reconstructed there. UI does not claim independent proof of historical canonical package bytes.
originalDto.sourceUnavailable: Public identity/assignee/revision/status and bounded metadata events only; source/vectors/reasons/original/current package content suppressed; no actions. No fallback full unfenced analysis.

limitations: Static design only; no runtime source API implementation inspected because not yet written.
No deployed security, customer data, CSV, retention or production release authority.
humanApprovalClaim: Only references explicit owner approval record; this review does not approve product decisions.

findings.finding: Profile section says prior DTO bytes remain exact; HTTP section explicitly adds planningTasks=null on older profiles. Those statements cannot both describe whole old HTTP wire JSON.
findings.impact: Could cause false compatibility evidence claims although approved behavior is clear.
findings.recommendation: Qualify unchanged historical DTO bytes to existing fields/values/order and saved envelopes; explicitly acknowledge the sole additive nullable task response field. No product behavior change.

reviewHistory.conclusion: No consequential product/security/architecture departure found. Engineering draft incorporates same-transaction source capture, monotonic observed sources, exact replay/duplicate precedence, immutable original references, metadata-only unavailable presentation and exact new-profile boundary.
